tcp_wrappers_enabled.description: Enable or disable TCP Wrappers access control (mod_wrap). When enabled, ProFTPD consults /etc/hosts.allow and /etc/hosts.deny before accepting connections.

hosts_allow_path.description: Path to the TCP Wrappers allow file (optional). Leave unset to use the default /etc/hosts.allow.

hosts_deny_path.description: Path to the TCP Wrappers deny file (optional). Leave unset to use the default /etc/hosts.deny.

access_rules.description: List of IP/hostname-based access control rules. Each rule applies to the specified FTP commands (limits) and may allow or deny specific clients.

comment.description: A short description of this rule (for readability in config).

limits.description: List of FTP command classes (e.g., ALL, LOGIN, READ, WRITE) this rule applies to.

allow.description: List of allowed hosts (IPs, hostnames, wildcards, or network/CIDR ranges) for these limits.

deny.description: List of denied hosts (IPs, hostnames, wildcards, or network/CIDR ranges) for these limits.

wrap_log_level.description: Log verbosity for TCP Wrappers access decisions. Use 'full' for deep debugging; 'none' to suppress logging.

wrap_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for TCP Wrappers hostname/hostname resolution before proceeding (prevents hangs on DNS failures).
